content:
Overview

Tampere is a city in Pirkanmaa with a population of 244,000. Finland’s sauna capital and industrial powerhouse, set between two lakes, known for its vibrant culture and education. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
